This is a senior-level software engineering role on NVIDIA's GPU cloud infrastructure team, focused on Kubernetes runtime and release engineering. The work involves building Go controllers and APIs that install, upgrade, and validate GPU cluster software, plus validation pipelines and automation for bringing new cloud providers and GPU hardware into production. The core stack is Go and Kubernetes — including controller-runtime, CRDs, and reconcilers — alongside Helm and Argo CD for delivery, in a distributed systems and public cloud context.
